title: Relationships -- relationships.yaml
description: SDD-R003 Universal Relationship Model. The source of every entry is implicit -- the owning Engineering Knowledge Object (SDD-R010 §6: relationships are authored per-object, one file per object, listing only relationships where that object is the source).

type.description: SDD-R003 §8. Checked against the known Relationship Type list by the validator (soft, extensible).

category.description: SDD-R003 §9. Organizational only; engineering meaning comes from `type`.

target.description: Object ID of the target Engineering Knowledge Object (SDD-R003 §7).

metadata.description: SDD-R003 §10 -- e.g. priority, weight, confidence, strength, directionality, optional, deprecated.

behavior.description: SDD-R003 §11 -- present only when behavior cannot be attributed to either endpoint independently.
